```sql
SELECT o.OPPORTUNITY_ID, e.ACCOUNT_NAME
FROM OFFICE_DW.SALESLOFT.OPPORTUNITIES o
LEFT JOIN OFFICE_DW.SALES.OPPORTUNITY_ENHANCED e
  ON o.OPPORTUNITY_ID = e.OPPORTUNITY_ID
WHERE LOWER(';' || o.TAGS || ';') LIKE '%;splunk;%'
   OR LOWER(o.TAGS) LIKE '%splunk%'
GROUP BY o.OPPORTUNITY_ID, e.ACCOUNT_NAME;
```
